Not to be nasty or anything (just informative), but for those of us still on 3.9.8, the errors mentioned below will spam the console in raid if an NPC spawns with this (seemingly until the die), which can run the game/PC out of memory pretty quickly, especially if multiple spawn at once. I’ve seen in excess of 140GB memory usage (Windows auto page file).

So as is this mod is currently unusable, took me a while to narrow it down as the error was ambiguous.
